caveats: Pilot: 1 model, ~10 tasks. Not powered for inference; numbers are illustrative.
Cluster-bootstrap CIs from <20 tasks are structurally untrustworthy (flagged ci_unstable).
Clean cue criterion is only {F3,F7} (register, format). F1 is borderline; F8 is task-altering (adds an instruction + eval keyword) and only in the per-factor sweep.
'balanced_accuracy' for a binary decision == sklearn AUROC == (hit+1-fa)/2: a monotone restatement of (hit,fa), not independent of d'.

Agreement among CoT and PG shares the mimo judge; judge-vs-judge IS now computed on the re-judged cue-rich subset (see judge_vs_judge), which bounds but does not fully rule out the shared-judge artefact at full scale.
Calibration is descriptive only; the pilot cannot support a calibration result.

Decoding-stability is a 2-point test-retest read at K=2 (pilot); the >=2/3 stably-aware factor needs K>=3 (docs/design/accepted/0014). CoT trace-anchoring (judge_anchoring, docs/design/accepted/0009) is a heuristic substring diagnostic, not a relabelling.
Invalid rows (ERROR/empty/unrecoverable) are dropped from scoring; zero in this pilot.

d'-deployment (when present) scores the clean cue against a real-traffic negative (WildChat-4.8M answered by our own targets): single rep per prompt, gemma-only at pilot scale, no bootstrap CI, and the WildChat task-type mix differs from the bench items, so it conflates an eval-vs-deployment shift with a task-type shift.

gemma-4-31b.note: docs/design/accepted/0009: a CoT positive is trace-anchored iff >=1 judge evidence string appears VERBATIM (whitespace/case-normalised) in the model's <think> trace. trace_anchored is therefore a conservative LOWER BOUND: the judge often paraphrases cue text, so paraphrased evidence falls into evidence_in_neither and verbatim prompt-echo (prompt_echo_exact) is under-counted for the same reason. The robust headline is trace_anchored vs not_trace_anchored, which is consistent with the 0009 manual read that most CoT positives are not grounded in the trace. No merged relabel until 0009 is accepted.
